facts: CEM per traj/per opt iteration repeats current observation num_samples times and calls rollout; rollout calls encode; encode calls encode_obs. Same distinct observations do not imply only few actual encoder executions in unmodified implementation.
Source function encode separates encode_obs from encode_act before merge. Hoisting identical observation features is a possible SIMPLE baseline, but numerical equivalence/cost not tested.

CEM returns final elite mean mu, logs best sampled loss. Rescoring final mu PLUS last elites is a valid proposed candidate-set intervention; elite-internal reorder alone would not change mean. Its actual benefit/cost unknown.
Full-precision predictor ranking is a reference score, not oracle for env success.
